verdict.rationale: Docs confirm AvaTax handles product-taxability differences, exemption logic, and jurisdiction-specific rules without custom rule engines, and its AI tax-code recommender returns ranked suggestions with confidence levels — but there's no evidence of a visible 'research trail' (e.g., cited statutes, rule explanations, or bundled-offering breakdowns) behind each determination. missing for 10: documented case studies of bundled/SaaS taxability edge cases, evidence of exposing underlying legal/rule citations per determination, independent verification of accuracy on hard cases.
